# observability (observability.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/observability/index.html.md>
Commands: `origin observability <command>`. Add `--output json` to every command whose output you read.

- **MetricService**: The metrics the platform collects for a project's compute instances, volumes and network interfaces: CPU time, network traffic, and volume reads and writes.

## Commands

### `origin observability query-time-series`

Returns a resource's time series for the metrics asked, one per metric, in the order asked.

```sh
origin observability query-time-series --parent <PROJECT> --resource <RESOURCE> --metric <METRIC> ... --start-time <TIME> --end-time <TIME> --period <DURATION> --statistic <STATISTIC>
```
